API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the list all active applications for a device
Gets the list all active applications for a device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/apps

Gets the list all active applications for a device. The endpoint gets the ZDX score each application. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
Example
SCHEMA
Array [
id
integer

The application ID.

name
string

The name of the application.

score
integer

The ZDX score of the application.

]
